# Explore Data Dictionary

**Purpose**: Import the data dictionary and investigate how variables and codes are defined. This exploration will inform the creation of validation functions to flag invalid or inconsistent values within the datasets.

## Load DD
```{r exploreDD-1}
DD_path <- paste0(act_directory,"Frz2024_DataDictionary_2025_06_06.xlsx")

DD_sheet_names <- excel_sheets(DD_path)

print(DD_sheet_names) ## 106 sheets in total

## remove the "Table of Contents" from sheet_names, we dont need to read it
DD_sheet_names <- setdiff(DD_sheet_names,"Table of Contents")

## read each sheet, skipping the first 5 rows, since they are meta info, not relevant
all_DD_sheets <- lapply(DD_sheet_names, function(sheet) {
  read_excel(DD_path, sheet = sheet, skip = 5)
})


## load sheet names of datasets and remove the DD sheets not present in the datasets
df_path <- paste0(act_directory,"ACT_353_Hohman_2025_09_11.xlsx")

df_sheet_names <- excel_sheets(df_path)

print(df_sheet_names) ## 32 sheets in total

## replace " - " with "_" in DD_sheet_names
DD_sheet_names <- gsub(" - ", "_", DD_sheet_names)

## check what other names should be modified in the DD_sheet_names:
setdiff(df_sheet_names,DD_sheet_names)
## [1] "Form78_InjuryLOC" "genetics_apoe"    "autopsy_status"   "np_standard"      "nic_cdes"         "nic_am_vols"     
## [7] "nic_pm_vols"   

DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Form78_InjuryLoc"] <- "Form78_InjuryLOC"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Genetics_APOE"] <- "genetics_apoe"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Autopsy_Status"] <- "autopsy_status"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Neuropathology_Standard"] <- "np_standard"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Neuroimaging_CDEs"] <- "nic_cdes"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Neuroimaging_AM_Vols"] <- "nic_am_vols"
DD_sheet_names[DD_sheet_names == "Neuroimaging_PM_Vols"] <- "nic_pm_vols"

setdiff(df_sheet_names,DD_sheet_names) ## character(0)

# name the DD sheet names list
names(all_DD_sheets) <- DD_sheet_names

## subset DD sheet names to be consistent with datasets
DD_sheet_names <- intersect(DD_sheet_names,df_sheet_names)

## remove irrelevant elements from the all_DD_sheets list
all_DD_sheets <- all_DD_sheets[DD_sheet_names] ## length = 32

## extract the Coding variables acorss all the DDs and check unique values
all_coding_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_DD_sheets), function(sheet_name) {
  df <- all_DD_sheets[[sheet_name]]
  
  # Ensure we only extract existing columns
  var <- if ("Variable" %in% names(df)) df$Variable else NA
  coding <- if ("Coding" %in% names(df)) df$Coding else NA
  type <- if ("Type" %in% names(df)) df$Type else NA
  
  # Repeat Df_name for each row of this tibble
  data.frame(
    Df_name = rep(sheet_name, length(var)),
    Variable = var,
    Coding = coding,
    Type = type,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

dim(all_coding_df) ## [1] 1374    4

## split by type
unique(all_coding_df$Type)

## explore NA and fill the missingness
print(all_coding_df[is.na(all_coding_df$Type),])
## Type = Num for those 3 NA
all_coding_df$Type[is.na(all_coding_df$Type)] <- "Num"

all_coding_df_chr <- all_coding_df[all_coding_df$Type == "Char",] ## 18 obs

all_coding_df_num <- all_coding_df[all_coding_df$Type == "Num",] ## 1359 obs
```

## Functions: Extract Valid Values for Numeric Variables

Patterns observed from DD

* "1 = xx\r\n2 = xx\r\n3 = xx\r\n. = xx"

* "Integer from 0 through 50\r\n88 = xx\r\n99 = xx\r\n. = xx"

* "Non-negative integers\r\n88 = xx\r\n99 = Txxr\r\n. = xx" 

* "Non-negative integers"

* "Positive integers, round to integer\r\n"
 
* "Positive real numbers, round to 2 decimals\r\n"

* "Positive real numbers (to 1 decimal)\r\n. = Missing"

* "Positive real numbers, round to 2 decimals\r\n. = Missing"

* "Positive real numbers, millimeters (mm)\r\n. = Missing"

* "Real numbers\r\n. = Missing"

* "Valid years starting in 1994"

* "Valid ages 65+"

* "Valid years\r\n.

* "Number of years\r\n. = Missing" ==> valid values: > 0

<br>

### Core Function
```{r exploreDD-2}
extract_valid_values <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || trimws(text) == "") {
    return(list(type = NA, valid_values = NA))
  }

  txt <- tolower(gsub("\r\n", " ", text))

  result <- list(type = NA, valid_values = NA)
  values <- numeric()
  range_vals <- NULL
  range_str <- NULL
  min_val <- NULL

  # ---- Extract explicit equality numbers ----
  # Capture things like "1 = ", "10=", "666.6 = something" etc.
  eq_nums <- regmatches(txt, gregexpr("\\b\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?\\s*=", txt))
  if (length(eq_nums[[1]]) > 0) {
    nums <- as.numeric(gsub("\\s*=.*", "", eq_nums[[1]]))
    values <- unique(nums)
  }


  # ---- Detect range patterns (outside code definitions) ----
  # Remove code definitions first so we don't confuse description ranges
  txt_no_eq <- gsub("\\b\\d+\\s*=.*?(?=\\b\\d+\\s*=|$)", "", txt, perl = TRUE)

  range_pattern <- "(from|between)?\\s*\\d+(\\s*(through|to|and|-|–)\\s*\\d+)"
  if (grepl(range_pattern, txt_no_eq)) {
    nums <- as.numeric(unlist(regmatches(txt_no_eq, gregexpr("\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?", txt_no_eq))))
    if (length(nums) >= 2) {
      range_vals <- nums[1]:nums[2]
      range_str <- paste0(nums[1], "-", nums[2])
    }
  }

  # ---- Detect keywords for type ----
  if (grepl("integer", txt)) result$type <- "integer"
  else if (grepl("real", txt)) result$type <- "numeric"

  # ---- Detect positive / non-negative ----
  if (grepl("non[- ]negative", txt)) min_val <- 0
  if (grepl("positive", txt)) min_val <- 0

  # ---- Detect "valid years/dates starting in X" ----
  if (grepl("valid (years|dates) starting in", txt)) {
    yr <- as.numeric(gsub(".*valid (years|dates) starting in\\s*(\\d+).*", "\\2", txt))
    if (!is.na(yr)) min_val <- yr
  }

  # ---- Detect "valid ages X+" ----
  if (grepl("valid ages", txt)) {
    age <- as.numeric(gsub(".*valid ages\\s*(\\d+)\\+.*", "\\1", txt))
    if (!is.na(age)) min_val <- age
  }

  # ---- Detect "number of years" ----
  if (grepl("number of years", txt)) min_val <- 0

  # ---- Build valid_values string ----
  valid_str <- NULL

  # Case 1: min value detected (>=)
  if (!is.null(min_val)) {
    valid_str <- paste0(">=", min_val)
  }

  # Case 2: range detected (outside of code defs)
  if (!is.null(range_str)) {
    if (length(values) > 0) {
      outside_vals <- setdiff(values, range_vals)
      if (length(outside_vals) > 0) {
        valid_str <- paste0(range_str, ",", paste(sort(outside_vals), collapse = ","))
      } else {
        valid_str <- range_str
      }
    } else {
      valid_str <- range_str
    }
  }

  # Case 3: discrete values only
  if (is.null(range_str) && length(values) > 0 && is.null(valid_str)) {
    valid_str <- paste(sort(unique(values)), collapse = ",")
  }

  # ---- Infer type if missing ----
  if (is.na(result$type)) {
    if (!is.null(valid_str) && grepl("^[0-9,\\-]+$", valid_str)) {
      result$type <- "integer"
    } else {
      result$type <- "numeric"
    }
  }

  result$valid_values <- valid_str
  return(result)
}

```

### Core Function Validation
```{r exploreDD-3}
## apply the function to the all_coding_df_num dataset to validate the function
generate_valid_values <- function(df) {
  # Apply the extraction function to each Coding cell
  parsed <- lapply(df$Coding, extract_valid_values)
  
  # Extract the two elements (type, valid_values) into separate columns
  df$type <- sapply(parsed, function(x) {
    ifelse(is.null(x$type) || is.na(x$type), NA, x$type)
  })
  
  df$valid_values <- sapply(parsed, function(x) {
    ifelse(is.null(x$valid_values) || is.na(x$valid_values), NA, x$valid_values)
  })
  
  return(df)
}

numValidVals <- generate_valid_values(all_coding_df_num)

DT::datatable(unique(numValidVals[,c("Coding","Type","type","valid_values")]))
```

# Variable Check Per File

## Functions: Check Valid Values

```{r varCheck-1}
validate_dataset <- function(dataset_name, IDcol = "ID") {
  # ================================================================
  # Function: validate_dataset()
  # Purpose:
  #   Validate dataset variables against validVals data dictionary:
  #     • Detect type mismatches
  #     • Flag invalid values (out-of-range or wrong format)
  #     • Identify decimals in integer fields
  #     • Return both a validation summary and corrected dataset
  # ================================================================

  # ---- 1. Retrieve dataset and dictionary ----
  if (!exists(dataset_name, envir = .GlobalEnv))
    stop(paste("Dataset", dataset_name, "not found in environment."))
  df <- get(dataset_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  if (!exists("validVals", envir = .GlobalEnv))
    stop("Reference table 'validVals' not found in environment.")
  validVals <- get("validVals", envir = .GlobalEnv)

  # ---- 2. Variable coverage check ----
  df_vars <- setdiff(names(df), IDcol)
  dd_vars <- validVals$Variable[validVals$Df_name == dataset_name]
  missed <- setdiff(df_vars, dd_vars)
  common_vars <- intersect(df_vars, dd_vars)

  cat("\n---------------- Variable Coverage Check ----------------\n")
  if (length(missed) == 0) {
    cat("All variables in", dataset_name, "were found in the data dictionary.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Variables missing from data dictionary for", dataset_name, ":\n  ",
        paste(missed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  cat("----------------------------------------------------------\n\n")

  # ---- 3. Extract relevant rules ----
  rules <- validVals[validVals$Df_name == dataset_name, ]
  results <- list()
  corrected_df <- df

  # ================================================================
  # 4. Loop through each common variable for validation
  # ================================================================
  for (varname in common_vars) {
    vals <- df[[varname]]
    obs_type <- class(vals)[1]

    # ---- Extract expectations from validVals ----
    spec <- rules[rules$Variable == varname, ]
    exp_type <- trimws(as.character(spec$type[1]))
    exp_values <- trimws(as.character(spec$valid_values[1]))  # ← keep original text
    coding_pattern <- trimws(as.character(if ("Coding" %in% names(spec)) spec$Coding[1] else NA))

    invalid_vals <- c()
    observed_vals_str <- NA

    # ================================================================
    # Phase 1: VALIDATION (no coercion)
    # ================================================================
    has_valid_values <- !is.na(exp_values) && trimws(exp_values) != ""
    uv <- unique(na.omit(vals))

    # ---- A. Type-based checks ----
    if (!is.na(exp_type)) {
      # Expected integer but decimal found
      if (tolower(exp_type) == "integer" && is.numeric(uv)) {
        non_integer_vals <- uv[(uv %% 1) != 0]
        if (length(non_integer_vals) > 0)
          invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, non_integer_vals)
      }

      # Character expected but numeric observed
      if (tolower(exp_type) == "character" && is.numeric(vals)) {
        invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, uv)
      }

      # Numeric expected but non-numeric observed
      if (tolower(exp_type) %in% c("numeric", "integer") && !is.numeric(vals)) {
        suppressWarnings(num_test <- as.numeric(vals))
        if (any(is.na(num_test) & !is.na(vals)))
          invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, vals[is.na(num_test)])
      }
    }

    # ---- B. Value-based checks ----
    if (has_valid_values && length(uv) > 0) {
      if (tolower(exp_type) %in% c("numeric", "integer")) {

        # Case 1: >= X
        if (grepl("^>=", exp_values)) {
          minval <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", exp_values))
          invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, uv[uv < minval])

        # Case 2: X-Y range
        } else if (grepl("^\\d+-\\d+$", exp_values)) {
          nums <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(exp_values, "-")))
          invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, uv[uv < nums[1] | uv > nums[2]])

        # Case 3: List like 0-4,8,9
        } else if (grepl("^[0-9,\\-\\.]+$", exp_values)) {
          parts <- unlist(strsplit(exp_values, ","))
          allowed <- c()
          for (p in parts) {
            if (grepl("-", p)) {
              rng <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(p, "-")))
              allowed <- c(allowed, seq(rng[1], rng[2]))
            } else {
              allowed <- c(allowed, as.numeric(p))
            }
          }
          invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, setdiff(uv, unique(allowed)))
        }
      } else if (tolower(exp_type) == "character") {
        allowed <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(exp_values, ",")))
        invalid_vals <- c(invalid_vals, setdiff(uv, allowed))
      }

      # ---- Observed values summary (trim to 8 for readability) ----
      observed_vals_str <- if (length(uv) > 8)
        paste(c(head(sort(uv), 8), "..."), collapse = ",")
      else paste(sort(uv), collapse = ",")

    } else {
      # Missing valid_values → manual check
      invalid_vals <- "Need manual check"
      exp_values <- coding_pattern  # keep Coding text
      if (is.numeric(vals)) {
        rng <- range(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
        observed_vals_str <- paste0(rng[1], "-", rng[2])
      } else if (is.character(vals)) {
        uv <- unique(na.omit(vals))
        observed_vals_str <- if (length(uv) > 8)
          paste(c(head(uv, 8), "..."), collapse = ",")
        else paste(uv, collapse = ",")
      }
    }

    # ---- Summarize invalids ----
    invalid_vals <- unique(na.omit(invalid_vals))
    invalid_vals_str <- if (length(invalid_vals) == 0)
      "Observed values all valid!"
    else paste(sort(invalid_vals), collapse = ",")

    # ---- Store results ----
    results[[varname]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = varname,
      Observed_type = obs_type,
      Expected_type = exp_type,
      Observed_values = observed_vals_str,
      Expected_values = exp_values,   # ← always use expression from validVals
      Invalid_values = invalid_vals_str,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # ================================================================
    # Phase 2: CORRECTION (after validation)
    # ================================================================
    if (!is.na(exp_type)) {
      if (tolower(exp_type) == "character") {
        corrected_df[[varname]] <- as.character(df[[varname]])
      } else if (tolower(exp_type) == "numeric" && !is.numeric(df[[varname]])) {
        suppressWarnings(corrected_df[[varname]] <- as.numeric(df[[varname]]))
      } else if (tolower(exp_type) == "integer") {
        suppressWarnings(corrected_df[[varname]] <- as.integer(round(as.numeric(df[[varname]]))))
      }
    }
  }

  # ================================================================
  # 5. Combine results & return
  # ================================================================
  validation_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, results))
  corrected_df <- as.data.frame(corrected_df)

  cat("Validation complete for dataset:", dataset_name, "\n")

  return(list(
    validation_report = validation_df,
    corrected_df = corrected_df
  ))
}

```

```{r Form77_SelfReportMeds-3}
med_cols <- paste0("SR_Med", 1:23)
observed_vals <- Form77_SelfReportMeds %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(med_cols)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit()

length(observed_vals) ## 1219 unique values

# --- Find invalid values (those not in medcode$Code) ---
invalid_vals <- setdiff(observed_vals, medcode$Code)
print(invalid_vals)
```

```{r}
## check columns need manual check: InjLoc1_Doc_Vis, InjLoc1_Hosp_Vis, InjLoc1_Recall_Vis, InjLoc2_Doc_Vis, InjLoc2_Hosp_Vis, InjLoc2_Recall_Vis, InjLoc3_Doc_Vis, InjLoc3_Hosp_Vis, InjLoc3_Recall_Vis

cols2check <- c("InjLoc1_Doc_Vis", "InjLoc1_Hosp_Vis", "InjLoc1_Recall_Vis", "InjLoc2_Doc_Vis", "InjLoc2_Hosp_Vis", 
                "InjLoc2_Recall_Vis", "InjLoc3_Doc_Vis", "InjLoc3_Hosp_Vis", "InjLoc3_Recall_Vis")

cols2checkUniqueVals <- lapply(cols2check, function(var) {
  uniq_vals <- unique(na.omit(Form78_InjuryLOC[[var]]))
  data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    Unique_values = paste(uniq_vals, collapse = ", ")
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

print(cols2checkUniqueVals)

## InjLoc1_Doc_Vis: Saw doctor for injury with LOC (1), as reported at visit
## InjLoc1_Hosp_Vis: Hospitalized for injury with LOC (1), as reported at visit
## InjLoc1_Recall_Vis: Remember leadup to injury with LOC (1), as reported at visit

## For those variables, I think 0 = No; 1 = Yes; 9 = Don't know / Refused (this coding is commonly used for othe datasets)
```

# Duplications

## Detection

```{r dup-detec-1}
## 1. find number of datasets with & without VISIT

df_w_VISIT <- c()
df_wo_VISIT <- c()

for (df_name in df_sheet_names) {
  df <- get(df_name)
  if(tolower("VISIT") %in% tolower(names(df))){
    df_w_VISIT <- c(df_w_VISIT,df_name)
  }else(
    df_wo_VISIT <- c(df_wo_VISIT,df_name)
  )
}

print(df_w_VISIT) ## 25
print(df_wo_VISIT) ## 7


## 2. duplications detection for datasets without VISIT
print("==================================================================")
print("Duplicates Detection for datasets without VISIT")
print("==================================================================")


for (df_name in df_wo_VISIT) {
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  dup <- df %>%
    group_by(e165_ID) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if(nrow(dup) > 1){
    cat("\n","Duplicates detected in dataset: ",df_name,"\n")
  }
  
}

## 3. duplications detection for datasets with VISIT
print("==================================================================")
print("Duplicates Detection for datasets with VISIT")
print("==================================================================")

for (df_name in df_w_VISIT) {
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  dup <- df %>%
    group_by(e165_ID,VISIT) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  if(nrow(dup) > 1){
    cat("\n","Duplicates detected in dataset: ",df_name,"\n")
  }
  
} 
## no duplicates found
```

## Fixing

There are three neuroimaging datasets in total: nic_cdes, nic_am_vols, and nic_pm_vols. Two of these datasets contain duplicate entries. Upon inspection, some duplicates occur several years apart, while others are much closer in time. 


<br>
<br>


# Common Columns

## Detection

```{r ccd-1}
## exclude neuroimaging datasets first then check common columns
cols2check <- setdiff(DD_sheet_names,c("nic_cdes","nic_am_vols","nic_pm_vols")) ## 29 datasets

commonColsDetect(cols2check)

```


## Fixing

```{r ccd-2}
## for each dataset, if columns: frm51 | frm75 | frm77 | frm78 | frm84 | frm85 are present, add suufix (dataset name) to the columns 

# Columns to check
target_cols <- c("frm51", "frm75", "frm77", "frm78", "frm84", "frm85")

# Loop through datasets
for (ds_name in cols2check ) {
  df <- get(ds_name)
  
  # Extract the second element of ds_name (split by "_")
  ds_suffix <- strsplit(ds_name, "_")[[1]][2]

  # Find columns present in both target list and dataset
  common_cols <- intersect(names(df), target_cols)
  
  if (length(common_cols) > 0) {
    # Create new names with dataset suffix
    new_names <- paste0(common_cols, "_", ds_suffix)
    
    # Rename those columns
    names(df)[match(common_cols, names(df))] <- new_names
    
    # Assign the modified df back to the same name
    assign(ds_name, df)
    
    cat("Updated columns in", ds_name, ":", paste(new_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r ccd-3}
## double check
commonColsDetect(cols2check)
```

# Merging

## Datasets without VISIT
```{r merge-1}
imagingDFs <- c("nic_cdes","nic_am_vols","nic_pm_vols")

df_names <- setdiff(df_wo_VISIT,imagingDFs)

merged <- get(df_names[1])
cat("=======================================================================","\n")
cat("Before merging: Info of ",df_names[1],":","\n")
info(merged,"e165_ID")
cat("\n")
  
for (dfname in df_names[2:length(df_names)]) {
  merged <- merge_with_info(
    df1name = "merged",
    df2name = dfname,
    merge_cols = "e165_ID",
    info_col = "e165_ID"
  )
}

```

```{r merge-2}
merged_woVISIT <- merged
```

<br>

```{r merge-3}
}
```
